name: Kurri Kurri Data Centre
notes: NSW Planning portal lists SSD-128819490 in Prepare EIS for construction, fit-out and operation of a data centre with total power consumption of 540 MW at the former Hydro Aluminium Kurri Kurri plant. DCD reports the applicant as ADW Johnson Pty Ltd and the intended end user as unclear.
